adjudication.rationale: In lib/tasks/disqus.thor the diff explicitly removes `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` and the subsequent `category_id` lookup and passing of `category: category_id` into `PostCreator`. The new implementation calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])` without any category parameter. This is a breaking change for existing invocations using `thor disqus:import -c <category>` (the option is no longer recognized) and it removes the ability to import into a specified category, causing imports to go wherever the default/new-topic logic places them.
